# SoundTouchJS core 2.1.1

Source: https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS/tree/d9e39a7ddcf74c7a145bbba45856f30068c82b79/packages/core

Lanczos strategy: https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS/tree/d9e39a7ddcf74c7a145bbba45856f30068c82b79/packages/interpolation-strategy-lanczos

These browser modules were generated from that pinned source using Node 24's stripTypeScriptTypes with transform mode. Type declarations and tests were omitted; the package import of the Lanczos strategy was changed to a local relative path. Processing algorithms are unchanged. The links above provide the original preferred source form. No runtime CDN dependency is added.
